node.label: India-Southeast Asia (Act East)
node.summary: India's ties with Vietnam and other ASEAN nations.

facts.text: NSA **Ajit Doval** held talks in Hanoi with Vietnam's Defence Minister Gen. **Phan Van Giang**. Relationship status: **Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership**.
facts.plain: NSA Ajit Doval held talks in Hanoi with Vietnam's Defence Minister Gen. Phan Van Giang. Relationship status: Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.

facts.text: **ADMM-Plus** began in **2010** (Hanoi): 10 ASEAN members plus 8 partners (India, China, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, Russia, US). The Philippines chairs ASEAN in 2026.
facts.plain: ADMM-Plus began in 2010 (Hanoi): 10 ASEAN members plus 8 partners (India, China, Japan, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, Russia, US). The Philippines chairs ASEAN in 2026.

facts.text: Defence Minister **Rajnath Singh** at the **13th ADMM-Plus** in **Cebu, Philippines** offered India's counter-terrorism expertise, proposed a defence **'Youth Bridge'** with ASEAN, and noted **2026** is the **ASEAN-India Year of Maritime Cooperation**; India and **Malaysia** co-chair the Experts' Working Group on Counter-Terrorism (2024-27).
